simple.prompt: Negative inversion with 'Not only': 'Not only ___ the data thoroughly, but they also uncovered fraud.'
simple.explanation: Not only di awal klausa mewajibkan inversi pola pertanyaan: auxiliary (did) + subjek (they) + verb dasar (audit).

simple.prompt: Inversion with 'Under no circumstances': 'Under no circumstances ___ unauthorized personnel enter the reactor room.'
simple.explanation: Under no circumstances + modal (may) + subjek (unauthorized personnel) + verb (enter).

simple.targetSentence: Rarely has such profound scientific progress been accomplished.
simple.explanation: Rarely + has (auxiliary) + such profound scientific progress (subject) + been accomplished (verb).
hints: Subjek dan pasif: 'such profound scientific progress been accomplished'.

simple.prompt: Inversion with 'Little': 'Little ___ that his research would ignite a medical revolution.'
simple.explanation: 'Little did + subject + verb' adalah formula klasik penekanan ketidaktahuan total di masa lalu.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi penekanan 'At no time'.
simple.targetSentence: At no time did the witnesses contradict their testimony.
simple.explanation: At no time + did the witnesses contradict + their testimony.
hints: Mulai dengan 'At no time did the witnesses'.

simple.prompt: Inversion with 'Seldom': 'Seldom ___ an orator captivate an audience so thoroughly.'
simple.explanation: Present simple habit/ability: Seldom + does + an orator (subjek tunggal) + captivate (verb dasar).

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi dengan 'No sooner... than'.
simple.targetSentence: No sooner had the treaty been signed than border clashes ceased.
simple.explanation: No sooner had the treaty been signed + than border clashes ceased.
hints: Mulai dengan 'No sooner had the treaty been signed'.

simple.prompt: Not only ___ the solar grid lower emissions, but it also stabilized rural voltage.
simple.explanation: 'Not only' di awal klausa memicu inversi Past Simple dengan auxiliary 'did' sebelum subjek 'the solar grid' + V1 'lower'.
hints: Perhatikan verb bentuk dasar 'lower' setelah subjek.

simple.prompt: Rarely ___ urban transit authorities completed a tunnel overhaul ahead of budget.
simple.explanation: Dengan Past Participle 'completed' di belakang subjek jamak 'urban transit authorities', inversi negatif 'Rarely' memakai auxiliary 'have'.

simple.prompt: Little ___ the night dispatchers realize that the backup fiber line had already switched over.
simple.explanation: 'Little' di awal bermakna negatif ('sama sekali tidak menyadari') diikuti inversi 'did + Subject + V1 (realize)'.

simple.prompt: Seldom ___ a single policy reform address both housing affordability and transit access equally.
simple.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'a single policy reform' + verb dasar 'address' memerlukan auxiliary Present Simple 'does' dalam inversi.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan dewan direksi dengan inversi negatif 'Never'.
dialogue: Board Member
Have we ever encountered such erratic customs tariffs in ten years?
Director
No — never ___ a sharper quarterly swing in import duties.
simple.explanation: Inversi setelah 'Never' di awal klausa mewajibkan auxiliary 'have' sebelum subjek 'we' ('Never have we seen...').

simple.prompt: Under no circumstances ___ temporary passwords be shared across messaging apps.
simple.explanation: Frasa preposisi negatif 'Under no circumstances' menarik modal 'must' ke posisi tepat sebelum subjek ('temporary passwords').
hints: Cari modal yang berada langsung setelah frasa negatif.
Inversi modal: 'Under no circumstances + must + S + be V3'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan lupa membalik auxiliary pada kalimat berawalan 'No sooner' berikut.
simple.draft: No sooner the cargo train cleared the tunnel than automated sensors lowered the crossing gates.
options: No sooner had the cargo train cleared the tunnel than automated sensors lowered the crossing gates.
No sooner did the cargo train cleared the tunnel than automated sensors lowered the crossing gates.
No sooner the cargo train cleared the tunnel when automated sensors lowered the crossing gates.
simple.explanation: Pembuka negatif 'No sooner' wajib membalik 'had' ke depan subjek + V3 ('No sooner had the cargo train cleared...') dan tetap berpasangan dengan 'than'.

simple.prompt: So ___ was the keynote address that not a single delegate checked their phone.
simple.explanation: Dalam pola inversi penekanan 'So + Adjective + be + Subject + that...', kata setelah 'So' sebelum linking verb 'was' harus berupa adjective ('compelling').

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi penekanan dengan 'Such + was'.
simple.targetSentence: Such was the precision of the laser scan that every microscopic fracture appeared clearly.
simple.explanation: 'Such + was + Noun Phrase + that + result clause' menonjolkan skala kualitas subjek.
hints: Awali dengan 'Such was the precision of the laser scan'.
Tambahkan klausa akibat 'that every microscopic fracture appeared clearly'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi negatif dengan 'At no point'.
simple.targetSentence: At no point did external auditors discover any missing petty-cash vouchers.
simple.explanation: 'At no point' di depan memicu inversi Past Simple: 'did + external auditors + discover'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'At no point did external auditors'.

dialogue: Speaker
Has any administration ever faced such multifaceted crises?
Historian
Never before in the annals of the republic ___ the sovereign institutions been tested so severely.
intermediate.explanation: Never before + auxiliary (have) + the sovereign institutions (subjek jamak) + been tested.

intermediate.prompt: Fronting an adjective for dramatic emphasis: '___ were his rhetorical gifts that even sworn adversaries were swayed.'
intermediate.explanation: Pola: 'So + adjective + were/was + subject + that...': 'So persuasive were his rhetorical gifts that...'.
hints: Pola: So + adj + to be + subject + that...

intermediate.prompt: Such inversion: '___ was the severity of the frost that citrus groves across the province perished.'
intermediate.explanation: Pola: 'Such + was/were + noun phrase + that...': 'Such was the severity of the frost that...'.

intermediate.targetSentence: Only when the audit was finalized did management realize the deficit.
intermediate.explanation: Only when the audit was finalized (adverbial clause) + did management realize (inversion) + the deficit.
hints: Mulai dengan anak kalimat waktu: 'Only when the audit was finalized'.
Inversi klausa utama: 'did management realize the deficit'.

intermediate.prompt: Inversion with comparative clause: 'The president delivered an address, as ___ all prime ministers before him.'
intermediate.explanation: Dalam klausa komparatif formal dengan 'as' atau 'than', inversi subjek-auxiliary lazim digunakan: 'as had all prime ministers...'.

intermediate.targetSentence: So profound was his grief that he retired from public life.
intermediate.explanation: So profound was his grief + that he retired from public life.
hints: Mulai dengan 'So profound was his grief'.
Klausa konsekuensi: 'that he retired from public life'.

dialogue: Director
Could the unauthorized intruder gain access without hardware tokens?
Engineer
On no account ___ the internal firewall permit external administrative logins.
intermediate.explanation: 'On no account will the firewall permit...' melarang keras akses dengan penekanan inversi modal.

intermediate.prompt: Such intense turbulence ___ the coastal drone encounter that engineers aborted the vertical mapping run.
intermediate.explanation: Struktur 'Such + Adjective + Noun + auxiliary + Subject + V1 + that...' memicu inversi 'did + the coastal drone + encounter' sebelum 'that...'.
hints: Perhatikan main verb bentuk dasar 'encounter' setelah subjek.

intermediate.prompt: Only after independent verification ___ the pharmaceutical board authorize commercial distribution.
intermediate.explanation: 'Only after + noun phrase' menunda inversi ke klausa utama: 'did the pharmaceutical board authorize'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan hukum mengenai struktur 'Not until'.
dialogue: Lawyer
When did your client learn about the undisclosed clause?
Witness
Not until the audit report circulated in October ___ of the hidden addendum.
intermediate.explanation: Setelah 'Not until + waktu/klausa' di depan kalimat, klausa utama berikutnya wajib mengalami inversi: 'did he become aware'.
hints: 'Not until...' berada di posisi awal kalimat.
Lakukan inversi pada klausa utama dengan 'did + S + V1'.

intermediate.prompt: Choose the sentence demonstrating ACCURATE Comparative Inversion without auxiliary duplication:
options: Urban air sensors measure particulates more accurately than do outdated manual stations.
Urban air sensors measure particulates more accurately than outdated manual stations does.
Urban air sensors measure particulates more accurately than are do outdated manual stations.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam gaya akademis formal, setelah 'than' atau 'as', auxiliary boleh mendahului subjek benda panjang ('than do outdated manual stations', mengacu kembali pada 'measure' yang jamak).
hints: Subjek di kanan 'than' jamak ('outdated manual stations') menggantikan aksi 'measure'.
Comparative inversion jamak memakai 'than do + S'.

intermediate.prompt: So rapid has smartphone banking adoption been across islands ___ traditional paper passbooks have nearly vanished.
intermediate.explanation: Meskipun bagian depan mengalami inversi ('So rapid has ... been'), konjungsi penutupnya tetap selalu 'that' (bukan 'than').

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan melakukan inversi auxiliary ganda pada klausa 'Only by' berikut.
intermediate.draft: Only by enforcing transparent procurement rules can municipal councils will eliminate kickbacks.
options: Only by enforcing transparent procurement rules can municipal councils eliminate kickbacks.
Only by enforcing transparent procurement rules municipal councils can eliminate kickbacks.
Only by enforcing transparent procurement rules do municipal councils can eliminate kickbacks.
intermediate.explanation: Jangan menumpuk dua modal ('can ... will')! Pindahkan satu modal 'can' ke depan subjek diikuti langsung V1 'eliminate'.
hints: Cukup gunakan satu modal inversi 'can + S + V1'.

intermediate.prompt: Wait — ___ in modern maritime history have two autonomous cargo vessels crossed this strait simultaneously.
intermediate.explanation: Frasa penguat negatif 'Never before' di awal kalimat memicu inversi 'have + Subject (two autonomous cargo vessels) + V3 (crossed)'.
hints: Ada auxiliary 'have' sebelum subjek di kalimat.
Hanya frasa negatif 'Never before' yang memicu inversi ini.

intermediate.prompt: Across the northern entrance of the botanical conservatory ___ a pair of century-old bronze sundials.
intermediate.explanation: Perhatikan inti subjek setelah verb dalam locative inversion: 'a pair of ... sundials'. Kata inti subjek adalah benda tunggal 'a pair', sehingga verb tunggal tanpa 'do' adalah 'stands'!
hints: Kata inti subjeknya adalah 'a pair' (tunggal), bukan 'sundials'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat comparative inversion yang formal dengan 'as'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Coastal wetlands shelter far more juvenile fish than do concrete seawalls.
intermediate.explanation: 'Than do concrete seawalls' membalik auxiliary jamak 'do' sebelum frasa subjek pembanding.
hints: Awali dengan 'Coastal wetlands shelter far more juvenile fish'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi formal memakai pola 'So + adverb + did'.
intermediate.targetSentence: So persuasively did the lead architect present the bridge model that the jury approved it unanimously.
intermediate.explanation: 'So + adverb + did + S + V1 + that...' mengangkat penekanan pada cara presentasi.
hints: Mulai dengan 'So persuasively did the lead architect present'.
Tambahkan klausa 'that the jury approved it unanimously'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan penempatan inversi pada klausa 'Only after'.
complex.draft: Only after did the regulatory body investigate the bank the accounts were unfreezed.
options: Only after the regulatory body investigated the bank were the accounts unfrozen.
Only after did the body investigate the bank were the accounts unfreezed.
Only after the body investigated did the accounts unfroze.
complex.explanation: Pada konstruksi 'Only after [clause]', klausa 'after' tetap menggunakan urutan kata normal (the regulatory body investigated). Inversi HANYA terjadi pada klausa utama: 'were the accounts unfrozen'. Selain itu, bentuk V3 dari freeze adalah 'unfrozen' (bukan unfreezed).

complex.prompt: Rhetorical stylistics: What distinct communicative value does inversion impart in formal and literary English?
options: It elevates informational salience, crafts dramatic suspense, and marks high rhetorical solemnity.
It converts declarative statements into colloquial jokes.
It is a syntactic error that authors try to hide.
complex.explanation: Inversi mengangkat derajat keterlihatan informasi (salience), menciptakan ketegangan artistik/dramatik, dan memberikan wibawa retoris tingkat tinggi.
hints: Meningkatkan bobot retoris dan ketegangan artistik.
Pilih opsi elevates informational salience and rhetorical solemnity.

complex.prompt: Inversion with participle fronting: '___ atop the ancient marble plinth was the bronze bust of Caesar.'
complex.explanation: Participle fronting (memajukan kata kerja past participle ke depan kalimat untuk efek dramatis): 'Perched atop the ancient plinth was...'.
hints: Participle pasif di awal kalimat mendahului to be.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat participle fronting sastra formal.
complex.targetSentence: Hanging from the gilded ceiling was a magnificent Venetian chandelier.
complex.explanation: Hanging from the gilded ceiling + was (verb) + a magnificent Venetian chandelier (subject).
hints: Mulai dengan participle tempat: 'Hanging from the gilded ceiling'.
Verb dan subjek: 'was a magnificent Venetian chandelier'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi struktur inversi komparatif ganda yang cacat.
complex.draft: So heavy the snowfall was that the mountain pass was closed for a fortnight.
options: So heavy was the snowfall that the mountain pass was closed for a fortnight.
Such heavy was the snowfall that the pass was closed.
So was the heavy snowfall that the mountain pass was closed.
complex.explanation: Pola baku: 'So + adjective (heavy) + was (verb) + the snowfall (subject) + that...'. Menempatkan subjek sebelum 'was' menghilangkan efek inversi yang dituju.
hints: Ganti menjadi 'So heavy was the snowfall'.

complex.prompt: Select the sentence with impeccable formal correlative inversion:
options: Not until the final ballots were tallied did either candidate concede defeat.
Not until were the final ballots tallied did the candidate concede.
Not until the final ballots tallied the candidate conceded.
complex.explanation: Urutan sintaksis sempurna: 'Not until [normal clause] did [subject] [base verb]'.
hints: Sintaksis sempurna: inversi pada klausa utama.

dialogue: Chief Justice
Can the executive order override statutory enactments?
Solicitor General
In no historical precedent ___ the executive claimed such unfettered prerogative.
complex.explanation: In no historical precedent + auxiliary has + the executive (subjek) + claimed (V3).
hints: Inversi preseden sejarah dengan auxiliary has.

complex.prompt: Analyze the stylistic risk in: 'Never have I seen such data. Seldom has a model failed so badly. Rarely do audits find this. Little did we suspect it.' Why should advanced writers limit consecutive inversions?
options: Overusing inversion in back-to-back sentences blunts rhetorical impact and creates melodramatic fatigue
Grammar rules forbid two negative inversions inside the same ten-page essay
Inversion reduces grammatical precision whenever Past Simple verbs appear
complex.explanation: Inversi adalah alat penekanan kuat (foregrounding); memakainya berturut-turut di setiap kalimat melunturkan daya pukau retorisnya dan membuat tulisan terdengar artifisial.
hints: Inversi paling efektif jika dipakai selektif pada titik argumen kunci.
Kelebihan inversi mengurangi efek kejut dan kewibawaan gaya.

complex.prompt: Examine Conditional-Concessive inversion with 'Were': '___ the board to withhold bridge financing, coastal ferries would still operate at reduced frequency.'
complex.explanation: 'Were + Subject + to + V1' adalah inversi hipotetis Second Conditional (setara 'If the board were to withhold...') yang berpasangan dengan 'would + V1'.
hints: Lihat struktur '...the board to withhold' dan hasil 'would still operate'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan membalik kata kerja transitif bersama pronoun subjek di locative/directional inversion berikut.
complex.draft: Into the crowded press auditorium strode he with a thick sheaf of audited tables.
options: Into the crowded press auditorium he strode with a thick sheaf of audited tables.
Into the crowded press auditorium did he stride with a thick sheaf of audited tables.
Into the crowded press auditorium was striding he with a thick sheaf of audited tables.
complex.explanation: Pada locative/directional inversion ('Into the auditorium...'), inversi verb sebelum subjek ('strode he') DILARANG apabila subjeknya adalah personal pronoun ('he', 'she', 'they', 'it') — kembalikan ke 'he strode'.
hints: Directional inversion menolak inversi pada personal pronoun.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan kritik akademis mengenai perbedaan fungsi 'Only when' vs 'Not until' di awal kalimat.
dialogue: Student
Both 'Only when the sample dried did we weigh it' and 'Not until it dried did we weigh it' invert the main clause. Is there any nuance?
Professor
'Only when' emphasizes the sole necessary condition, whereas 'Not until' specifically highlights ___ before that moment.
options: the prolonged delay or absence of the action
a higher statistical margin of error
informal spoken agreement between lab shifts
complex.explanation: 'Not until X' menyorot fakta bahwa sebelum titik waktu X, tindakan itu belum terjadi (menekankan lamanya penantian/batas awal), sedangkan 'Only when X' menyoroti syarat eksklusifnya.
hints: Bandingkan makna penekanan 'belum terjadi sampai...' vs 'hanya ketika...'.

complex.prompt: Nowhere in the twenty-chapter regulatory statute ___ any explicit exemption for automated trading bots.
complex.explanation: Jika kalimat 'there is / there appears' diinversi oleh 'Nowhere...' di awal kalimat, kata kerja bantu + 'there' berpindah berurutan sebelum subjek: 'Nowhere ... does there appear + subject'.
hints: Inversi 'Nowhere...' + Present Simple dengan 'there' menjadi 'does there appear'.

complex.prompt: Had the maritime authority ___ acted upon those early sonar warnings, neither cargo barge would have run aground.
complex.explanation: Di antara subjek 'the maritime authority' dan V3 'acted' dalam inversi Third Conditional ('Had + S + adverb + V3'), adverb cara diletakkan tepat sebelum V3.
hints: Posisi di antara subjek dan past participle 'acted'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menggabungkan 'Not only' tanpa pengulangan bentuk auxiliary/tense yang sesuai pada kalimat formal berikut.
complex.draft: Not only had the courier misread the postal code, but also was ignoring urgent dispatch messages.
options: Not only had the courier misread the postal code, but he had also ignored urgent dispatch messages.
Not only the courier had misread the postal code, but also ignored urgent dispatch messages.
Not only did the courier misread the postal code, but also was ignoring urgent dispatch messages.
complex.explanation: Setelah inversi klausa lengkap di depan ('Not only had the courier misread...'), klausa kedua setelah 'but' wajib memiliki subjek ('he') dan verb paralel Past Perfect ('had also ignored'), bukan mengandalkan subjek tanpa pronoun dengan tense progresif janggal.
hints: Sediakan subjek 'he' di klausa kedua setelah 'but'.
Selaraskan aspek Past Perfect di kedua klausa.

complex.prompt: To such an alarming degree ___ coastal erosion accelerated that municipal engineers relocated three cliffside roads.
complex.explanation: Perhatikan V3 'accelerated' di belakang subjek 'coastal erosion' — bentuk Present Perfect ('has ... accelerated') lebih akurat dibanding 'did' (yang harus diikuti V1 'accelerate') atau 'was' (pasif tak tepat di sini).
hints: Cek bentuk participle 'accelerated' (V3) dan sifat intransitif erosi di sini.
Hanya 'has' membentuk aktif Present Perfect 'has accelerated'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi formal dengan frasa pembuka negatif eksistensial 'Nowhere ... is there'.
complex.targetSentence: Nowhere in the revised charter is there any clause permitting unilateral fee hikes.
complex.explanation: 'Nowhere + place + is there + subject' membalik 'there is' setelah keterangan tempat negatif.
hints: Awali dengan 'Nowhere in the revised charter is there'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat comparative inversion formal membandingkan dua metode riset.
complex.targetSentence: Controlled field trials isolate causal variables far more reliably than do retrospective surveys.
complex.explanation: 'Than do retrospective surveys' menempatkan auxiliary jamak 'do' tepat sebelum subjek panjang pembanding.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Controlled field trials isolate causal variables'.
Akhiri dengan 'far more reliably than do retrospective surveys'.
